I am farming here in Rukwa, and the land is good for maize but the rains decide everything. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer this year, so I will use the cow manure from my animals like my father taught me. I will plant the seed I saved from last season together with beans between the rows, and my wife and children will help me weed. When weeding time comes and the work is too much, I will call some neighbors and pay them a little to finish in time.
